riskMatch.name: Match by Risk
riskMatch.desc: Map investor risk tolerance to customer risk profiles
riskMatch.detail: Ensures alignment between investor risk appetite and customer risk levels. Conservative investors will be matched with low-risk customers, while aggressive investors can accept higher-risk customers.

priorityRate.name: Priority by Rate
priorityRate.desc: Prioritize allocations based on expected returns
priorityRate.detail: Determines allocation order based on expected return rates. "Lowest first" optimizes for investor benefits, while "Highest first" maximizes platform revenue.

capacityLimit.name: Capacity Limit
capacityLimit.desc: Set maximum exposure limits per investor or product
capacityLimit.detail: Prevents over-concentration by limiting maximum allocation amounts or percentages per investor, product type, or region. Helps maintain portfolio diversification.

liquidityReserve.name: Liquidity Reserve
liquidityReserve.desc: Maintain minimum liquidity buffer in allocation pool
liquidityReserve.detail: Keeps a percentage of total funds unallocated to handle unexpected redemptions, market volatility, or operational requirements. Recommended: 5-15%.

whitelistBlacklist.name: Whitelist/Blacklist
whitelistBlacklist.desc: Include or exclude specific investors from allocations
whitelistBlacklist.detail: Allows manual control over investor participation. Whitelist prioritizes preferred investors, while blacklist excludes problematic or restricted investors.

productEligibility.name: Product Eligibility
productEligibility.desc: Restrict allocations to specific product models
productEligibility.detail: Defines which financing products are eligible for allocation. Useful for creating specialized strategies or complying with investor mandate restrictions.

minBalance.name: Minimum Balance
minBalance.desc: Set minimum available balance requirement for investors
minBalance.detail: Ensures investors maintain sufficient liquidity before participating in allocations. Prevents over-commitment and maintains healthy cash reserves.

manualOverride.name: Manual Override
manualOverride.desc: Require manual approval for specific conditions
manualOverride.detail: Pauses automatic allocation when certain thresholds or conditions are met, requiring manual review and approval before proceeding. Essential for risk management.

s2.title: Risk Mapping Configuration
s2.subtitle: Define risk profile alignment between customers and investors to ensure optimal allocation matching.
s2.guidelinesText: Customer risk profiles represent creditworthiness and default probability. Investor risk tolerance indicates their appetite for potential losses. Proper alignment ensures sustainable returns and satisfied investors.
s2.customerProfilesHelp: Select which customer risk categories this strategy will handle. Risk scores: Low (0-30), Medium (31-70), High (71-100).
s2.toleranceMappingHelp: Define which customer risk levels each investor tolerance can accept. Conservative investors typically prefer low-risk customers only.
s2.recommendedText: Conservative investors should only accept Low risk customers. Balanced investors can accept Low-Medium risk. Aggressive investors can accept all risk levels.
s2.exposureLimitsLabel: Portfolio Exposure Limits per Risk Band
s2.exposureLimitsHelp: Set minimum and maximum exposure percentages for each risk category to maintain portfolio balance and comply with risk management policies.
s2.bestPracticeText: Ensure total exposure limits don't exceed 100%. Consider regulatory requirements and investor mandates when setting these limits.

s3.title: Rule Builder
s3.availableRulesHelp: Click to add rules to your strategy. Rules are executed in priority order.
s3.noRulesHelp: Add rules from the left panel to build your strategy

riskMatch.tip: 💡 This rule maps investor risk tolerance levels to customer risk profiles for optimal matching.

priorityRate.tip: 💡 This rule determines the order of allocation based on expected return rates.

capacity.tip: 💡 Set maximum exposure limits to maintain diversification and reduce concentration risk.

liquidity.tip: 💡 Maintain a buffer for unexpected redemptions and market volatility. Recommended: 5-15%.
liquidity.reserveHelp: Percentage of total pool to keep unallocated

whitelist.tip: 💡 Control investor participation by including preferred investors or excluding problematic ones.
whitelist.holdCtrl: Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select multiple investors

product.tip: 💡 Restrict allocations to specific product models based on investor mandates or strategy focus.

minBalance.tip: 💡 Ensure investors maintain sufficient liquidity before participating in new allocations.

manual.tip: 💡 Pause automatic allocation when specific conditions are met, requiring manual review.

s4.title: Allocation Weighting & Global Limits
s4.subtitle: Configure rule priorities and set portfolio-wide risk management limits to ensure balanced allocations.
s4.weightsHelp: Assign relative importance to different rule categories. Higher weights mean stronger influence on allocation decisions. Total should equal 100%.
s4.globalCapsHelp: Set maximum concentration limits to prevent over-exposure to any single investor or product type. These are hard limits that cannot be exceeded.
s4.minSlicesHelp: Set the smallest allocation amount to reduce micro-transactions and administrative overhead.
s4.typicalRange: Typical range: 10,000 - 100,000 SAR depending on product type and operational efficiency.

s5.title: Scheduling & Notifications
s5.executionModeHelp: Choose how and when this strategy should execute allocations. Real-time is most responsive, batch is most efficient, manual provides maximum control.
s5.batchTip: 💡 Batch processing reduces system load and allows for better optimization across multiple allocations.
s5.alertsHelp: Configure automatic notifications for critical events. Helps ensure quick response to issues and maintains operational oversight.

realtime.label: Real-time Execution
realtime.desc: Execute immediately when funds become available
realtime.details: Best for: High-frequency allocations, urgent funding needs, immediate investor satisfaction

batch.label: Batch Processing
batch.desc: Execute allocations on a fixed schedule
batch.details: Best for: Operational efficiency, cost reduction, consolidated processing

manual.label: Manual Execution Only
manual.desc: Require explicit approval for each allocation
manual.details: Best for: High-risk strategies, regulatory compliance, testing new approaches

failure.title: Allocation Failure Alerts
failure.desc: Immediate email to operations team when allocation fails

exposure.title: Exposure Threshold Alerts
exposure.desc: Alert when investor or product exposure approaches limits (80% of max)
exposure.help: Helps prevent breaches and maintains portfolio balance

manual.title: Manual Approval Required
manual.desc: Notify when manual override rules are triggered
manual.help: Ensures prompt review of exceptional cases

success.title: Daily Success Summary
success.desc: Daily report of successful allocations and performance metrics
success.help: Sent at 6 PM local time to management team

s6.title: Strategy Review & Publication
s6.subtitle: Review all configuration details before publishing. Once published, the strategy will become active and start processing allocations.
s6.checklistText: Ensure all required fields are completed, rules are properly configured, and limits are within acceptable ranges. Published strategies become active immediately and will start processing real allocations.
s6.name: Name:
s6.impactManual: Manual review required for each allocation
s6.nextStep1: Run a simulation to validate strategy performance with current market data
s6.nextStep2: Review with risk management team if this is a new strategy type
s6.nextStep3: Ensure operations team is aware of new allocation patterns
s6.nextStep4: Consider starting with a limited pilot before full deployment
s6.readyText: Your allocation strategy is properly configured and ready to go live. Once published, it will begin processing allocations according to your specifications.

translation.aboutText: Tanmeya Capital is a pioneering sharia-compliant financing platform offering a wide range of flexible and innovative solutions, with commercial registration (1010337706) licensed by the Saudi Central Bank No. 22/أ ش/201410 dated 11/19/1435 AH
translation.aboutTextOne: Established in 2012, the company, with capital 500,000,000 SR , has a head office in Riyadh and 16 branches located in 13 cities across Kingdom, it specializes in providing flexible financial leasing, small and medium enterprises financing, productive assets and consumer financing, subject to control and supervision The Central Bank of Saudi Arabia.
translation.postext: POS Financing is the fastest financing facility, It is a quick fix for your business problems. This facility can be availed within 24 hours and can be utilised for 30 days. Below are the salient features for POS Financing product
translation.usText: Within our values and the Islamic Shari’a spirit and principles, we have started our journey in 2012. And throughout, we have been inspired to deal with our clients and partners, and that’s how we started. Tanmeya Capital launched its operations promoting its financing services for individuals and SME’s in compliancy with the Islamic Shariah principles, by providing a variety of financing products that our individual and corporate clients entail.
